subject: Reminder: warehouse stocktake this Saturday - Pasir Panjang
body:
Hi team,

A quick reminder that our quarterly warehouse stocktake takes place this Saturday from 9am at the Pasir Panjang facility. Please coordinate with your leads so counting teams are rostered and the floor is cleared by Friday evening.

The attached notice has the section assignments and safety briefing times. Reach out if your team has a scheduling clash.

Thanks for the support,
Daniel Ong
Operations Coordinator
Pacific Link Shipping Pte Ltd
15 Pasir Panjang Road, #06-02
Singapore 118486
